description: Rewritten temporal_stability enrichment that achieves 20+ distinct scores across synthetic corpus. Must use MULTIPLE metadata fields: first_seen, last_updated, version_count, release_frequency_days, maintenance_activity. Compute score from recency-weighted maintenance frequency. Add jitter or fine-grained bucketing to break the 3-value plateau. Pure function compute_score(metadata) returning (float, dict). No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Must pass enrichment_harness.py with 20+ distinct score threshold.
